# ADR-3260: AWS root_mfa: Root email without monitored inbox for account 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unmonitored root email misses recovery and alerts.

## Decision

Accounts MUST NOT keep a root email without monitored inbox for account 4 (AWS-root_mfa-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Security-owned aliases receive root mail.
